items.title: Walter Koenig, Chekov of ‘Star Trek’ fame, dies at 90
items.brief: Walter Koenig, who played exuberant Russian navigator Pavel Chekov on the original “Star Trek” series and many of the franchise’s ensuing films, has died at the age of 90.

items.title: Iran hosts Saudi Arabia and regional powers as fears grow of return to war
items.brief: Saudi Arabia and its allies dispatched top security officials to Iran for talks on Monday amid fears of a fresh US-Israeli offensive that could plunge the Middle East into further instability.

items.title: UN panel: Russia is committing crimes against humanity by targeting civilians in Ukraine
items.brief: Russia is committing war crimes and crimes against humanity by intentionally attacking civilian infrastructure – including vital energy systems – in Ukraine, an independent UN investigations panel said on Monday.

items.title: How Lula beat Bolsonaro, broke records and halted the region’s right-wing wave
items.brief: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva made history on Sunday.

items.title: 15-year-old will be charged as an adult after 11 people were shot near Florida A&M University stadium
items.brief: A 15-year-old faces 11 counts of attempted second-degree murder and possession of a firearm by a delinquent in connection with a mass shooting Saturday night that left 11 people wounded, Tallahassee police said.
